canonicalToken.notes: V1 remains canonical until V2 is deployed, independently verified, balance-reconciled, release-authorized, and explicitly cut over.

legacyToken.notes: Existing Base token remains canonical until V2 is deployed, verified, reconciled, and explicitly approved for cutover.

v1Snapshot.notes: This is a dated read-only accounting snapshot, not a claim that balances remain unchanged after the observation time.

cutoverRequirements: Deploy AetheronV2 on Base Mainnet through the gated deployment entrypoint.
Verify deployed source and runtime invariants on BaseScan and through read-only RPC calls.
Reconcile the dated V1 balance snapshot against the intended V2 migration plan and preserve a reviewable mapping.
Do not reuse the expired legacy presale as a V2 presale because its token address is immutable.
Choose and verify the canonical Base AMM pool before registering it in V2.
Create liquidity only after opening-price and liquidity-size decisions are explicitly reviewed in the signing wallet.
Enable trading only after liquidity, public-site configuration, and final launch checks all agree on the verified V2 address.
Update the public token registry only after the V2 deployment, migration evidence, and cutover authorization are verified.
